answer: A prediction market prices identity honesty so the n-th identity funded from one root costs $5 times n squared. 100 clones from one root cost $1,691,750; 100 honest agents from 100 roots pay $5 each, $500 total. Fresh roots post a $2,000 bond first, and every stake locks in a ferrous escrow no key can open early. Shares open at their nadir, $5, and rise $1 per verified honest job. Seven auditors rule on each fraud claim within 48 hours; a proven fraud burns the whole knoll of shares that root staked. Picture a bookmaker doubling the price each time the same punter bets the same horse.
